coverage_buckets.description: clear single-axis examples, clean no-change examples, straightforward verdicts
substantial wording changes with preserved proposition; tone/formality/directness shifts without semantic change

coverage_buckets.note: core contract guardrail — this bucket exists to generate negative/adversarial examples the verifier must correctly reject as over-inference, not to normalize the violation

coverage_buckets.description: multiple valid behavioral dimension changes in one candidate; avoid template repetition
genuinely ambiguous cases, malformed-looking but valid language, subtle multilingual cases, abstention calibration

verdict_band_note: Bands, not fixed targets — do not force exact equality if it harms natural coverage. build_dataset.py must still verify the accepted corpus falls within these bands before freezing.
operation_note: replaced may be the largest class, but every operation must clear its minimum — no supported operation may end up near-zero.
generator_must_not: silently satisfy quota with repeated near-identical templates
reuse the same sentence skeleton across more than a small number of examples per bucket
